subsystems.name: Cold-atom source
subsystems.role: produces a cloud of ultra-cold atoms that can be manipulated coherently.

subsystems.name: Laser and optical system
subsystems.role: cools, launches, splits and recombines the atoms.

subsystems.name: Interferometer and detection
subsystems.role: turns the atoms into a sensitive gravity or acceleration probe.

subsystems.name: Vibration and environmental isolation
subsystems.role: keeps platform motion and field noise from swamping the atomic signal.

subsystems.name: Control and signal processing
subsystems.role: runs the pulse sequence and extracts the phase shift.

subsystems.name: Navigation integration
subsystems.role: combines the drift-free atomic measurement with high-bandwidth classical sensors.

subsystems.name: Ruggedised enclosure
subsystems.role: makes the laboratory instrument survive vehicles, ships and aircraft.

buildSteps.title: Make and hold the vacuum
buildSteps.detail: The chamber is baked and sealed to ultra-high vacuum, then an alkali metal source is loaded so atoms can be trapped without collisions.

buildSteps.title: Cool and trap atoms
buildSteps.detail: Six laser beams and a magnetic field form a magneto-optical trap, slowing atoms to microkelvin temperatures — a few millionths of a degree above absolute zero.

buildSteps.title: Launch the atoms
buildSteps.detail: The cloud is thrown upwards or released in free fall, giving a clean vertical measurement path.

buildSteps.title: Split, redirect and recombine
buildSteps.detail: Laser pulses act as beam splitters and mirrors, placing each atom in a superposition of two momentum states that travel along different paths before recombining.

buildSteps.title: Read out the interference
buildSteps.detail: Laser light detects how many atoms ended in each state; the resulting fringe pattern carries the phase shift.

buildSteps.title: Convert phase to gravity or acceleration
buildSteps.detail: The measured phase is compared with the known laser pulse timings to give an absolute value of gravitational acceleration or platform acceleration.

buildSteps.title: Fuse with classical sensors
buildSteps.detail: Because the atomic measurement is absolute but slower and noisier at high frequency, it is blended with accelerometers and gyroscopes to give a drift-free navigation solution.

buildSteps.title: Ruggedise and calibrate
buildSteps.detail: The instrument is shock-mounted, thermally stabilised, magnetically shielded and checked against a reference gravity site before field deployment.

buildSteps.title: Deploy and operate
buildSteps.detail: It runs from a vehicle, ship or aircraft, either surveying gravity or feeding a navigation filter where satellite signals are degraded or unavailable.

prerequisites.tech: Laser cooling and trapping of atoms
prerequisites.why: without microkelvin atoms the interference time is too short to be useful.
the atomic phase depends on laser frequency and timing being controlled to extreme precision.
cold atoms must be isolated from background gas for the measurement to survive.

prerequisites.tech: Vibration isolation and classical inertial sensors
prerequisites.why: platform motion is often larger than the gravity signal, so it must be measured and removed.
today's field instruments are still bulky and power-hungry compared with conventional sensors.
the hard step for navigation is keeping accuracy while the platform is accelerating and turning.

pathway.milestone: commercial cold-atom gravimeters used for geophysical survey, volcano and groundwater monitoring
pathway.unlocks: absolute gravity measurements with no drift, which classical relative gravimeters cannot give over long surveys.

pathway.milestone: shipborne and airborne cold-atom gravimetry and gravity gradiometry
pathway.unlocks: faster, cheaper mapping of mineral, oil and gas prospects under water and ice.

pathway.milestone: compact quantum inertial measurement units tested for GNSS-denied navigation
pathway.unlocks: drift-free position keeping for submarines, underground vehicles and urban operations where satellite signals are jammed or blocked.

pathway.milestone: hybrid quantum-classical navigation systems in routine use
pathway.unlocks: resilient navigation that does not depend on external signals, plus precise geodetic reference data.
